50 Jones Luxury Apartments in Downtown San Francisco, CA, Now Open.


SF’s urban oasis lives at Jones + Market
Amongst the hustle and bustle of Mid-Market, one of San Francisco's hottest emerging neighborhoods, sits an oasis for everyday living at 50 Jones. With Muni and BART out your front door and SoMa and downtown a short walk away, your day starts with convenience at our upscale apartments in Downtown San Francisco, CA. When you come home, multiple relaxing designer spaces, from the solarium to the rooftops to the secluded courtyard Oasis, including The Oasis, a landscaped courtyard with a fire pit, social and relaxing spaces, and Sky Terrace features social seating and amazing views, help you leave your worries outside. Your dreams of city living and respite come together at 50 Jones. Contact us to schedule a tour.



GALLERY
modern design +
rich history

This storied entertainment neighborhood is alive again, with renewed focus. 50 Jones embraces the history, while moving it forward with modern comforts for today’s living.

VIEW GALLERY +
AMENITIES
refined finishes +
relaxing amenities

Carefully considered, but never uptight, 50 Jones offers the perfect place to come home to. Whether it’s watching movies in the courtyard Oasis, or soaking up the sun with friends on the roof deck, our attention to detail makes a long day that much easier.

SEE AMENITIES +
NEIGHBORHOOD
secluded oasis +
central location

Experience living with everything you need right around the corner. From dining, to shopping, to a quick commute to work, 50 Jones provides the best of both worlds conveniently located near SoMa and Union Square.

EXPLORE SF'S MID MARKET +
NOW OPEN
guided +
virtual tours available

We are excited to announce our leasing office is now open and offering partially self-guided tours, by appointment only. Not able to swing by? We also have virtual tours available online.

CONTACT US TO SCHEDULE A TOUR +
